title: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic

hero.headline: Every Number's Unique Fingerprint
hero.subtext: Har composite number ko prime factors ke ek hi unique combination mein likha ja sakta hai.

story.text: Jaise har insaan ka fingerprint unique hota hai, waise hi har number ka prime factorization unique hota hai — order chahe kuch bhi ho. 12 hamesha 2×2×3 hi rahega, chahe tum likho 2×3×2 ya 3×2×2.

explanation.content: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic (FTA) kehta hai: har composite number ko prime numbers ke product ke roop mein likha ja sakta hai, aur ye factorization unique hoti hai (factors ke order ko chhod kar).
Iska sabse bada use hai HCF aur LCM nikaalna jab prime factorization pata ho:
HCF = product of smallest powers of common primes
LCM = product of greatest powers of all primes involved

examples.problem: 96 aur 404 ka HCF aur LCM prime factorization se nikaalo.

questions.question: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic kis cheez ki uniqueness batata hai?
questions.explanation: FTA kehta hai har composite number ka prime factorization unique hota hai (order chhod kar).

questions.question: Agar HCF(a,b) = 4 aur a×b = 240, to LCM(a,b) kya hoga?
questions.explanation: HCF × LCM = a × b, isliye LCM = 240/4 = 60.

notes: Har composite number = unique prime factors ka product
HCF = common primes ki smallest powers
LCM = saare primes ki greatest powers
HCF × LCM = Product of the two numbers
summary: FTA se hume pata chalta hai ki prime factorization unique hai — isi se HCF aur LCM turant nikal sakte hain, bina long division ke.
